translations.literal: In the second year he held the post of Military Governor of Sha Prefecture and again served as deputy deployment commissioner of Bing and Dai.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was Military Governor of Sha and again deputy deployment commissioner of Bing and Dai.

sentences.zh: 至道中，李繼遷擾西鄙，絕靈武糧道，命昭遠為靈州路都部署，護二十五州芻粟，竟達靈武，繼遷不敢犯。

translations.literal: In the Zhidao era Li Jiqian harassed the western frontier and cut the grain route to Lingwu; Zhaoyuan was appointed deployment commissioner of the Lingzhou route, escorted fodder grain from twenty-five prefectures, and in the end reached Lingwu; Jiqian did not dare attack.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhidao, Li Jiqian cut Lingwu's grain route. Zhaoyuan was made deployment commissioner of the Lingzhou route, escorted fodder from twenty-five prefectures to Lingwu, and Jiqian did not dare strike.

sentences.zh: 真宗即位，徙定州行營都部署。

translations.literal: When Zhenzong took the throne, he was transferred to deployment commissioner of the Ding Prefecture field headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: At Zhenzong's accession he was moved to deployment commissioner of the Ding field headquarters.

sentences.zh: 未幾，拜保靜軍節度使，充天雄軍都部署、知府事。

translations.literal: Before long he was appointed Military Governor of the Baojing Army, serving concurrently as deployment commissioner of the Tianxiong Army and prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was Military Governor of Baojing, deployment commissioner of Tianxiong, and prefect.

sentences.zh: 咸平二年，移知河陽，數月卒，年五十六。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianping he was transferred to govern Heyang; several months later he died at fifty-six.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianping 2 he was transferred to Heyang; months later he died at fifty-six.

sentences.zh: 時車駕在大名，為廢朝。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage was then at Daming; court audiences were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was then at Daming; the court suspended audiences.

sentences.zh: 贈太尉，諡惠和，中使護葬。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made Grand Marshal; his posthumous title was Huihe; an imperial envoy supervised the burial.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Grand Marshal, given the posthumous title Huihe, and an imperial envoy oversaw the burial.

sentences.zh: 昭遠頗知書，性吝嗇，所至無善政。

translations.literal: Zhaoyuan was fairly learned in books but by nature stingy; wherever he went there was no good government.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaoyuan knew books but was miserly by nature; nowhere he served left good government.

sentences.zh: 母弟昭懿亦事晉邸，至捧日都虞候。

translations.literal: His younger brother of the same mother, Zhaoyi, also served the Jin princely establishment and rose to Chief Commandant of the Sun-Upholding [Guard].
translations.idiomatic: His uterine brother Zhaoyi also served Taizong's princely household and rose to Chief Commandant of the Sun-Upholding Guard.

sentences.zh: 弟昭遜，西京作坊使。

translations.literal: His younger brother Zhaoxun was Commissioner of the Western Capital Workshops.
translations.idiomatic: Younger brother Zhaoxun was Commissioner of the Western Capital Workshops.

sentences.zh: 初，祖母郭氏嘗對昭遠母指昭遠曰：「此兒有貴相，他日必至公侯。」

translations.literal: Earlier, his grandmother Lady Guo had once said to Zhaoyuan's mother, pointing at Zhaoyuan: "This boy has the countenance of nobility; someday he will reach the rank of duke or marquis."
translations.idiomatic: Once his grandmother Lady Guo told Zhaoyuan's mother, pointing at him: "This boy has a noble face; one day he will reach duke or marquis."

sentences.zh: 指昭懿曰：「此兒奉錢過二萬，不能勝矣。」

translations.literal: Pointing at Zhaoyi she said: "This boy will receive more than twenty thousand in cash and cannot bear it."
translations.idiomatic: Pointing at Zhaoyi: "This one will take in more than twenty thousand cash—and will not be able to bear it."

sentences.zh: 果皆如其言。

translations.literal: In the end both came about as she had said.
translations.idiomatic: Both prophecies came true.

sentences.zh: 昭遠子懷普，九歲事太宗左右，至西京左藏庫使、平州刺史。

translations.literal: Zhaoyuan's son Huaipu, at nine sui, attended Taizong's side and rose to Commissioner of the Western Capital Left Treasury and prefect of Ping Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaoyuan's son Huaipu attended Taizong from age nine and rose to Commissioner of the Western Capital Left Treasury and prefect of Ping.

sentences.zh: 懷一，供備庫副使。

translations.literal: Huaiyi, Deputy Commissioner of the Supply Reserve Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Huaiyi was Deputy Commissioner of the Supply Reserve Bureau.

sentences.zh: 懷正，內殿承制。

translations.literal: Huaizheng, Inner Hall Director.
translations.idiomatic: Huaizheng was Inner Hall Director.

sentences.zh: 懷英，內殿崇班。

translations.literal: Huaiying, Inner Hall Honored Ban.
translations.idiomatic: Huaiying was Inner Hall Honored Ban.

sentences.zh: 三年，詔知瀛州兼兵馬鈐轄，領富州刺史，遷東上閤門使。

translations.literal: In the third year he was ordered to govern Ying Prefecture concurrently as military controller, to hold the post of prefect of Fu Prefecture, and was promoted to Commissioner of the Eastern Upper Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was ordered to govern Ying Prefecture as military controller, hold Fu Prefecture, and was promoted Commissioner of the Eastern Upper Gate.

sentences.zh: 端拱二年，知滄州，移邢州，皆兼鈐轄。

translations.literal: In the second year of Duangong he governed Cang Prefecture, then was transferred to Xing Prefecture; in both posts he concurrently served as military controller.
translations.idiomatic: In Duangong 2 he governed Cang, then Xing—both times as military controller.

sentences.zh: 淳化初，與王文寶並命為四方館使，連護鎮、定州屯兵。

translations.literal: Early in the Chunhua era he and Wang Wenbao were together appointed commissioners of the Four Directions Bureau and in succession guarded the garrison troops at Zhen and Ding.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Chunhua he and Wang Wenbao were named commissioners of the Four Directions Bureau and in turn guarded the Zhen and Ding garrisons.

sentences.zh: 改知貝州，移高陽關兵馬鈐轄。

translations.literal: He was changed to govern Bei Prefecture and transferred to military controller at the Gaoyang Pass.
translations.idiomatic: He was moved to Bei Prefecture, then to military controller at Gaoyang Pass.

sentences.zh: 五年，知定州，與兵馬部署王榮不協。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he governed Ding Prefecture and was at odds with deployment commissioner Wang Rong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he governed Ding Prefecture and fell out with deployment commissioner Wang Rong.

sentences.zh: 榮素粗暴，因忿毆憲仆地，憲怏怏致疾，數日卒，年六十三。

translations.literal: Rong was by nature brutal; in a fit of anger he beat Xian and knocked him to the ground; Xian, resentful and dejected, fell ill and died within days at sixty-three.
translations.idiomatic: Rong was brutal by nature; in rage he struck Xian down. Xian took to his bed in bitterness and died within days at sixty-three.

sentences.zh: 王賓，許州許田人。

translations.literal: Wang Bin was a native of Xutian in Xu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Bin came from Xutian in Xu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 小心謹願。

translations.literal: He was careful and respectful in manner.
translations.idiomatic: He was careful and respectful in manner.

sentences.zh: 年十餘，事宣祖左右，及長，善騎射。

translations.literal: When he was just over ten he attended at the side of the dynastic founder; when grown he was skilled at horseback archery.
translations.idiomatic: From his early teens he attended the dynastic founder; grown, he was skilled at mounted archery.

sentences.zh: 太宗領兗海節制，太祖以署府中右職。

translations.literal: When Taizong held the Yanhai command, Taizu had him appointed to a senior post in the princely mansion.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizong commanded Yanhai, Taizu placed him in a senior post in the princely mansion.

sentences.zh: 太平興國初，補東頭供奉官、亳州監軍。

translations.literal: Early in the Taiping Xingguo era he was made an attendant of the Eastern Head, military supervisor of Bo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Taiping Xingguo he became Eastern Head attendant and military supervisor of Bo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 賓妻妒悍，賓不能制，時監軍不許挈家至任所，妻擅至亳，賓具白上。

translations.literal: Bin's wife was jealous and fierce; Bin could not control her; at the time military supervisors were not permitted to bring families to their posts, yet his wife went on her own to Bo; Bin reported the full matter to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Bin's wife was fiercely jealous and he could not control her. Supervisors were forbidden to bring families to post, yet she went to Bo on her own; Bin reported it to the throne.

sentences.zh: 太宗召其妻，俾衛士捽之，杖百，以妻忠靖卒，一夕死。

translations.literal: Taizong summoned his wife, had the guards seize her and give a hundred blows with the staff, and assigned her to a soldier of the Loyal Tranquility [corps]; in one night she died.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong summoned her, had guards seize her and give a hundred strokes of the staff, then married her off to a Loyal Tranquility soldier; she died that night.

sentences.zh: 遷賓儀鸞副使，領內酒坊。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Vice Commissioner of Ceremonial Paraphernalia and placed in charge of the inner wine bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Vice Commissioner of Ceremonial Paraphernalia and placed in charge of the inner wine bureau.

sentences.zh: 從征太原，又從征范陽，與彰信節度劉遇攻城東面。

translations.literal: He followed the campaign against Taiyuan and also followed the campaign against Fanyang, and with Zhangxin Circuit military governor Liu Yu attacked the eastern side of the city.
translations.idiomatic: He followed the campaign against Taiyuan and also the campaign against Fanyang, and with Zhangxin military governor Liu Yu attacked the eastern side of the city.

sentences.zh: 五年，車駕北巡，副王仁贍為大內都部署。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, when the imperial carriage toured the north, he served as deputy to Wang Renzan as Grand Inner Deployment Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, when the emperor toured the north, he served as deputy to Wang Renzan as Grand Inner Deployment Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 七年，改洛苑使。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was changed to Luoyuan Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was made Luoyuan Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 會汴漕壅滯，軍食不給，詔別置水陸發運兩司，以賓有心計會，領演州刺史，與儒州刺史許昌裔同掌其事。

translations.literal: When Bian transport was blocked and army provisions could not be supplied, an edict separately established land-and-water dispatch offices; because Bin had a calculating mind he was made to govern Yan Prefecture and together with Ruzhou prefect Xu Changyi managed the affair.
translations.idiomatic: When Bian transport was blocked and army provisions ran short, an edict established separate land-and-water dispatch offices; because Bin had a calculating mind he was made prefect of Yan and together with Ruzhou prefect Xu Changyi managed the affair.

sentences.zh: 凡四年，儲積增羨，號為稱職，俄改右神武將軍。

translations.literal: Altogether four years; stored grain increased with surplus and he was regarded as fulfilling his duties; soon he was changed to Right Divine Martial General.
translations.idiomatic: For four years stored grain increased with a surplus and he was regarded as competent; soon he was made Right Divine Martial General.

sentences.zh: 黎陽當舟車交會，禁兵常屯萬餘，以度支使張遜薦，命賓護黎陽軍，兼領黃、御兩河發運事，俄領本州團練使。

translations.literal: Liyang lay at the junction of boats and carts; forbidden troops were regularly stationed in excess of ten thousand; on Revenue Commissioner Zhang Xun's recommendation Bin was ordered to guard Liyang Army and concurrently head Yellow and Imperial River dispatch affairs; soon he also headed his prefecture's training commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Liyang lay at the junction of boats and carts with more than ten thousand forbidden troops regularly stationed; on Zhang Xun's recommendation Bin was ordered to guard Liyang Army with concurrent charge of Yellow and Imperial River dispatch; soon he also headed his prefecture's training commissioner.

sentences.zh: 以賓請黎陽建通利軍，命就知軍事。

translations.literal: On Bin's request Tongli Army was established at Liyang and he was ordered to govern it in place.
translations.idiomatic: At Bin's request Tongli Army was established at Liyang and he was ordered to govern it in place.

sentences.zh: 賓規起公署、郵館，供帳之器咸具。

translations.literal: Bin planned and raised the public offices and postal stations; supplies and furnishings were all provided.
translations.idiomatic: Bin planned and built the public offices and postal stations with all supplies and furnishings provided.

sentences.zh: 加本軍大將軍，歲別給錢二百萬，俄兼河北水陸路轉運使。

translations.literal: He was added Grand General of that army; each year he was separately granted two million cash; soon he also headed Hebei land-and-water transport.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Grand General of that army with an annual grant of two million cash; soon he also headed Hebei land-and-water transport.

sentences.zh: 賓事宣祖、太祖、太宗殆六十年，最為勤舊，故恩寵尤異，前後賜賚數千萬，俱奉釋氏。

translations.literal: Bin served Taizu of Zhou, Taizu, and Taizong for nearly sixty years and was among the most diligent veterans; therefore favor was especially unusual; grants before and after totaled tens of millions, all devoted to Buddhism.
translations.idiomatic: Bin served the Zhou founder, Taizu, and Taizong for nearly sixty years among the most diligent veterans; favor was especially great and grants totaled tens of millions, all devoted to Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 在黎陽日，按見古寺基，即以奉錢修之，掘地丈餘，得數石佛及石碣，有賓姓名，賓異其事以聞。

translations.literal: While at Liyang he inspected an old temple foundation and used his salary to repair it; digging more than a zhang down he obtained several stone Buddhas and a stone stele bearing Bin's name; Bin reported the matter as extraordinary.
translations.idiomatic: While at Liyang he found an old temple foundation and used his salary to repair it; digging more than a zhang down he found stone Buddhas and a stele bearing his name, which he reported as extraordinary.

sentences.zh: 詔名寺為淳化，賜新印經一藏、錢三百萬以助之。

translations.literal: An edict named the temple Chunhua, granted a new set of sutras, and three million cash to assist.
translations.idiomatic: An edict named the temple Chunhua, granted a new set of sutras, and three million cash to assist the work.
